risks: The test harness requires the suite to use only POSIX shell and BusyBox-provided utilities, and to write temporary files only under $WORK.
Do not modify existing files under tests/ or run linekit or the test suite during implementation.
steps: Implement usage_wrap and cmd_wrap in lib/cmd_wrap.sh. Parse -w with getopts, validate WIDTH against [1-9][0-9]*, use the common error helpers, check FILE readability, then greedily wrap words while treating blank lines as paragraph separators.

Add tests/t_wrap.sh using run/check/check_error. Cover A1–A14, including width boundaries, whitespace normalization, paragraph separation, unterminated input, multiple files, and invalid or missing width arguments.
Add wrap and its description to the README.md command table; follow the documented Conventions and Tests requirements.
Leave existing test files untouched and do not run the suite or linekit. The pipeline will run sh tests/check.sh.
